id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

by.description: Who pushed: the agent a harness named, or the person. Recorded by Chips.

anyOf.description: A commit, by its full git object id.

before.description: Where `main` was, or `null` for the project's first push.

commits.description: How many commits the push added to `main`.

message.description: The first line of the newest commit's message.

path.description: Its path in the project, with `/` between folders.

added.description: Lines added; `null` for a binary file.

removed.description: Lines removed; `null` for a binary file.

files.description: What changed between `before` and `after`, in path order.

more_files.description: How many more files changed than are named.

file_count.description: How many files `main` has now, for the room sheet's Project tile (ADR 0222).

undoes.description: The change this one takes back, when it is a person's Undo, or Put it back's Undo of an Undo (ADR 0222).

description: Somebody's push moved the room's project forward: who, which commits, and the files they changed.
title: ProjectChanged
